## Type of change

- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `feat`: new feature
- [ ] `docs` / `test` / `refactor` / `ci` / `chore`
- [ ] **Breaking change** (public API, CSS token, behavior): described below and in `CHANGELOG.md`

## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat(scope): ...`).
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and `dotnet test` passes locally.
- [ ] Public types and members have XML documentation.
- [ ] `README.md` / `docs/` are updated, and the examples compile against the real API.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## [Unreleased]` for user-visible changes.
- [ ] Checked in the render modes / platforms concerned (Static SSR, Server, WebAssembly, MAUI Blazor Hybrid).
